title: Verify ordinary text reader audio and registry sources
changes: Compare the recorded home scene with registry sources altered, including full state, audio and exact observed table slots.
validation: Windows GNU release test build registry-ordinary-audio-build-retry-ubarl3z6 passed. Wine registry-ordinary-audio-wine-8672kdim passed all 1800 recorded frames against E170-d169: complete state, clock, central/wide video, OAM and five nonempty audio streams matched each frame while 116 registry/literal source bytes were altered. The managed path read 28 callback bytes; seven typed table requests address only null slot 3, with no dropped trace requests. Protected inputs passed, scratch was removed and Wine server drained.

Build m8_zss8o compiled and checked inputs but its final receipt was marked FAIL after the session pipe broke. The subsequent build passed. Wine logged a D-Bus assertion but continued to a passing test.
limitations: Observed slot 3 is null; address observation does not establish callback invocation or ordinary slot 11. Generated dispatch may fall back to interpretation. Other scenes and consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurement.
